parameters.toolDescription: Obtiene la hora actual en Madrid - util para saber la fecha y hora del sistema
Obtiene las 10 llamadas mas recientes con su estado, duracion y sentimiento. Usa esto para ver la actividad reciente del call center.
parameters.query: SELECT id, direction, status, caller_number, called_number, duration_seconds, sentiment, initiated_at, ended_at FROM calls WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY initiated_at DESC LIMIT 10

parameters.toolDescription: Obtiene estadisticas generales de llamadas: total de llamadas, duracion promedio, tasa de exito, llamadas por estado. Usa esto para reportes y metricas.
parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_llamadas, ROUND(AVG(duration_seconds)::numeric, 1) as duracion_promedio_segundos, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 END) as completadas, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'transferred' THEN 1 END) as transferidas, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'in_progress' THEN 1 END) as en_curso, COUNT(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 END) as sentimiento_positivo, COUNT(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 END) as sentimiento_negativo, COUNT(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'neutral' THEN 1 END) as sentimiento_neutral FROM calls WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND initiated_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'

parameters.toolDescription: Obtiene las llamadas de hoy. Usa esto para ver la actividad del dia actual.
parameters.query: SELECT id, direction, status, caller_number, called_number, duration_seconds, sentiment, initiated_at FROM calls WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND DATE(initiated_at) = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY initiated_at DESC

parameters.toolDescription: Busca llamadas con sentimiento negativo de los ultimos 7 dias. Util para identificar clientes insatisfechos que requieren atencion.
parameters.query: SELECT id, caller_number, duration_seconds, sentiment, initiated_at, status FROM calls WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND sentiment = 'negative' AND initiated_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY initiated_at DESC LIMIT 20

parameters.toolDescription: Obtiene las llamadas que fueron transferidas a un agente humano. Util para analizar casos que la IA no pudo resolver.
parameters.query: SELECT id, caller_number, duration_seconds, sentiment, initiated_at, transfer_reason FROM calls WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'transferred' AND initiated_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY initiated_at DESC LIMIT 20

parameters.toolDescription: Cuenta el numero de contactos registrados en el sistema.
parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_contactos, COUNT(CASE WHEN marketing_opt_out = false THEN 1 END) as aceptan_marketing, COUNT(CASE WHEN marketing_opt_out = true THEN 1 END) as rechazan_marketing FROM contacts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
